rca_of_the_issue: The attempted backfill derives posting_location_code directly from the sales_invoice_no prefix. Myntra sales invoices use MYN/..., but return invoices use prefixes such as MYSRI- and PSCM. Because the fallback takes the first six characters when no slash exists, return rows are stored as MYSRI-/PSCM instead of MYN. Reproduction: login as admin@fundle.ai/admin123, call /api/sales?portal=myntra&txn_type=Return&limit=10, or open Sales Ledger for 2026-04 Myntra and filter Sale Type=Return; Location displays MYSRI-.
